title: Zhongnan Mountains
shortSummary: The Zhongnan Mountains are a real landscape near Chang'an and a layered setting for cultivation, reclusion and religious narrative.
curatorialDescription: Real geography and sacred narratives coexist here, but the map and symbolic cosmos must remain separate views.
